documentary_reports.quoted_passage_original: dieses Refort Cotatenga ift A. 1670. 1678. 1682. und 1686. wegen ihres vielfältigen Meineydes durch der Niederländischen Ost-Indischen Compagnie Waffen gäntzlich ruinirt, nachmahls aber wieder zu Bundes-Genossen auf und angenommen worden
documentary_reports.quoted_passage_translation: this fort/place Cotatenga was, in the years 1670, 1678, 1682, and 1686, on account of their manifold perjury/oath-breaking, entirely ruined by the arms of the Dutch East India Company, but afterward again received and admitted as allies
documentary_reports.provenance_status: CD_INDEPENDENT (memoir tier, distinct from CD/archival primary and from buku-padang-1718 secondary-academic, per the existing Phase B Parent-Episode Review's own provenance assignment)
documentary_reports.evidence_scope_note: This single retrospective sentence is the SOLE evidentiary basis for 1678 and 1686 specifically (Vogel-only years). It provides CORROBORATING but not independently-dated confirmation for 1670 (which also has an earlier, independent buku-padang-1718/Valentijn source) and PARALLEL, non-confirmed-corroborating evidence for 1682 (which also has an independent CD3-primary pardon instrument describing an apparently different specific act). The report's own retrospective, single-clause, non-itemized framing of 'vielfältigen Meineydes' (manifold oath-breaking) covering all four years is NOT treated by this artifact as neutral proof that all four years shared one cause, one actor, or one classification.
documentary_reports.notes: Modeled as a distinct DocumentaryReport entity, per Draft V2 section 1's KEEP_RESEARCH_ONLY DocumentaryReport class and section 5's rule that a report's own date must be kept distinct from the event date(s) it describes -- report_date (c.1690) is recorded separately from each destruction year's own event date (1670/1678/1682/1686).

vocabulary_notes.relation_type_restraint: USES_MILITARY_FORCE_AGAINST is used for all four Vogel-referenced destruction years (1670/1678/1686 targeting LOCATION_KOTO_TANGAH or the coastal collective; 1682's Pouti execution targeting the individual actor). No DESTROYS, REPEATEDLY_COERCES, FAILS_TO_DETER, REBELS_AGAINST, OATH_BREAKER_OF, or SUBMITS_TO relation type was created, per the explicit hard rule.
